subject: E-Commerce
title: The Payment Method Map
description: A fast breakdown of The Payment Method Map for builders.

hook.text: Credit cards dominate the US but only 20% of e-commerce payments in Europe. Every region pays differently.

buildup.text: The Netherlands uses iDEAL, Poland uses BLIK, India uses UPI, Brazil uses Pix. Local methods rule.

discovery.text: Offering only credit cards in Germany means losing 60% of potential customers who prefer other payment methods.

twist.text: Payment processors like Stripe and Adyen handle 50+ local methods automatically. The tech exists; adoption lags.

climax.text: Payment localization is as important as language localization. Customers won't buy if they can't pay their way.

punchline.text: iDEAL, BLIK, UPI, Pix. Credit cards are a US habit, not a global standard.

quiz.question: Why is offering only credit cards a problem in global e-commerce?
options: Many countries prefer local payment methods, and credit card-only loses customers
